notes: Blocks you build with the Building Book no longer earn Skills XP, Guilds reputation or Daily Quest progress when broken, and towns leave them alone.
Land Claims pop back out pistons and slime or honey blocks placed beside someone else's claim, and break pistons that push blocks into one.
Town Projects no longer duplicate lecterns, barrels or smokers when a spot is removed or rebuilt, and a Treasure Map cairn's lantern no longer drops as a free item.
Many packs now recognize dead bushes, lily pads, item frames, note blocks and rooted dirt, so the Minimap draws them properly.
A creative player no longer gives party mates Defeat progress, Wanderers state real distances, and choosing an ordinary moon before a full moon sticks.

build_bp.notes: Every Building Book build, paste and undo or redo reports its blocks with realm:blocks_placed, so towns leave them alone and Skills, Guilds and Daily Quests give nothing for breaking them.

skills_bp.notes: Listens to realm:blocks_placed and remembers up to 500 boxes in skills:pbox, so blocks broken inside a book-built box give no XP.

guilds_bp.notes: Listens to realm:blocks_placed and remembers up to 500 boxes in guilds:pbox, so blocks broken inside a book-built box give no reputation or extra drop.

quests_bp.notes: Book-built blocks give no quest progress (quests:pbox), a creative killer no longer gives party mates Defeat progress, and daily picks use a fair shuffle.

claims_bp.notes: A piston, sticky piston, slime block or honey block placed within 2 blocks of someone else's claim pops back out, and a piston outside a claim that moves blocks into it breaks a moment later.

town_bp.notes: Remove spot and Rebuild drop a job block's contents but not the block itself, and menus in a dimension with no towns say No towns in this dimension.

maps_bp.notes: Cleanup takes a marker down from the top so a cairn's lantern no longer drops, and cleanup record ids cannot collide.
